ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 70-75% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels covering the remaining 25-30% focused in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white lateral lobes. A contiguous black geometric region originates at the fluke base (peduncle) and extends symmetrically into the medial portions of both lobes. Distal tips show localized black pigmentation, with the right tip exhibiting a more extensive dark terminal patch compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch is a deep V-shape with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; the lower vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. The right trailing edge features a high-amplitude indentation (gap) approximately 20% of the distance from the distal tip, followed by moderate-frequency jagged contours toward the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges sweeping from the distal tips toward the median notch; leading edges exhibit a consistent convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible along the distal margin and lower ventral surface of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) are visible on the distal third of the right lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct high-amplitude indentation or missing tissue segment on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distal to the central notch.
